Message:
drm/i915: Standardize on 'cpp' for bytes per pixel

We more or less randomly call the "bytes per pixel" value
'cpp', 'bytes_per_pixel', 'pixel_size', or even 'bpp'. Let's just pick
one and stick to it. I've chosen 'cpp'.
